semiconductor_relevance: High — Agilent Technologies provides critical analytical tools and measurement solutions essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Agilent Technologies specializes in analytical instruments and software that are vital for quality control and process optimization in the semiconductor industry. Their solutions, including advanced ICP-MS systems, support trace element analysis and yield improvement in semiconductor fabrication.
capabilities: Triple Quadrupole ICP-MS for trace element analysis
LA-ICP-MS for direct solid sample analysis
Automation solutions for sampling and reporting
Elemental analyzers including ICP-OES and atomic absorption spectrometry

regional_presence.China: Agilent Technologies operates in China, providing analytical solutions tailored for the local semiconductor market.
